site.name: Apprentix
site.tagline: European apprenticeship and VET data, made searchable.
site.blurb: An independent project that takes publicly available European data on apprenticeship and vocational education and republishes it in a form you can search, filter and compare — rather than read one page at a time.

datasets.title: Apprenticeship schemes in Europe
datasets.tagline: How apprenticeship is designed, governed and paid for across Europe.

datasets.title: VET policy timeline
datasets.tagline: National VET and apprenticeship policies since 2015, and how far each has got.

datasets.title: Apprenticeship and VET open-data catalogue
datasets.tagline: Open datasets on apprenticeship and vocational training, found across Europe's national data portals.
datasets.coverage: 27 countries plus EU-level publishers, via data.europa.eu

datasets.title: Financing apprenticeships: instruments
datasets.tagline: Levies, training funds, tax incentives and grants that pay for apprenticeships.

datasets.title: Recognising foreign VET qualifications
datasets.tagline: Who informs, who decides and under which law foreign VET qualifications are recognised, in 30 European systems.
datasets.coverage: EU-27 (Belgium's Flemish and French Communities separately), Iceland and Norway, as at June 2026

datasets.title: Erasmus+ accredited VET organisations
datasets.tagline: Every organisation holding an Erasmus accreditation in vocational education and training since 2021.
datasets.coverage: 33 countries (EU-27, EEA and candidate countries), accreditation calls 2021–2025

datasets.title: Centres of Vocational Excellence projects
datasets.tagline: Every Erasmus+ Centre of Vocational Excellence partnership since 2021, and who takes part.

datasets.title: Qualification levels in national frameworks
datasets.tagline: Where apprenticeship and other qualifications sit in 43 national frameworks, and at which EQF level.
datasets.coverage: 43 frameworks (EU, EFTA, candidate countries), state of play 2024

datasets.title: VET systems in Europe
datasets.tagline: Where to read each country's VET system description, and who wrote it.

datasets.title: National VET qualifications in Europe
datasets.tagline: Vocational qualifications at EQF levels 2–5 from national registers, as published to Europass.
datasets.coverage: 14 countries (AT, BE-Flanders, CZ, DE, EE, FR, IE, LV, LT, MT, NL, RS, SI, SE), EQF levels 2–5
